summary: FE-tested the 3 AI features under CRM Settings → Price List. Bundle Suggest (suggestions only) works end-to-end up to suggestion rendering (5 items returned by AI). Create-bundle action FAILS silently (no bundle-created-<idx> state appears). Drawer AI-clean could NOT be reached: product rows expose text links ('View' / 'Edit') with NO data-testid='product-view-*' (or any product-view testid) – the spec implies such a testid; main agent should add it. Import-wizard AI summary could NOT be reached: uploading the provided sample xlsx returns HTTP 413 (Payload Too Large) at upload step, so preview never renders.

critical.issue: Click on bundle-create-0 with 5 suggestions present did not produce bundle-created-0 within 3.5s; no JS console error captured but the success state never appeared. Likely API error response not surfaced in the modal (only setError fallback). Needs investigation: server logs / response body.
413 Payload Too Large when uploading /app/test_samples/pulse_master_price_list_sample.xlsx (~7193 rows). Blocks the entire AI-summary preview flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Row 'View' / 'Edit' links have no data-testid (expected product-view-<id>) – cannot deterministically open product drawer for AI-clean testing.

After clicking Create bundle the 'Created' state never appears; modal lacks visible error feedback when /crm/products POST fails (error rendered only via setError but no toast/inline feedback near the row).

integration_issues.issue: Create-bundle API call presumably failing or extremely slow; success state not observed in 3.5s. No bundle-created-0 element present.

integration_issues.flow: Import wizard preview → AI explain issues
integration_issues.issue: Upload fails with 413, so plw-ai-summary-block never renders.

action_items: Add data-testid='product-view-<id>' (and/or product-row-<id>) to the View/Edit links in CRMProductsSection so the product drawer can be opened in tests and so spec test-ids match.

Debug 'Create bundle' POST /api/crm/products – check backend logs; surface API error in CRMBundleSuggestModal (current error only set via setError but is in the same scroll area – add inline error per row).

Raise upload size / row limit (or stream) for the import wizard so the supplied 7193-row sample workbook does NOT return 413. Alternatively, add a frontend pre-trim option BEFORE upload (deselect sheets pre-upload) – currently sheet checkboxes only appear after a successful upload, so users can't avoid 413.
Once the above is fixed, re-test plw-ai-summary-block / plw-ai-summary-btn / plw-ai-summary-result and bundle-created-<idx> flow end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMBundleSuggestModal.createBundle: on success it sets createdIdx but does NOT verify the API response (no id check). If POST returns 2xx with empty body the Created flag still flips; if it errors it falls through to setError shown once at top – consider per-row error feedback.
CRMProductsSection should expose data-testid='product-view-<id>' on the table-row view affordance to align with the documented spec.
Import wizard appears to upload the whole xlsx then ask the user to pick sheets – inefficient for 7k-row files. Consider streaming parse or chunked upload to avoid 413.
Cookie/install-app prompt overlay covers controls near the bottom of the screen on first load – consider auto-suppressing during onboarding flows.

success_rate.frontend: ~33% (1 of 3 features partially verified end-to-end: bundle suggestions rendered; create-bundle, drawer AI clean, and wizard AI summary all blocked)

test_credentials: admin@gymaxisai.com / MasterAdmin123! (CRM master admin via inline /crm login)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via inline CRM login on /crm (placeholder you@gym.com). Navigate to Settings using URL ?tab=settings then click [data-testid=settings-tab-products] (NOT 'settings-products' – that testid is absent). Suggest Bundles button works and AI returned 5 suggestions in ~19s. To exercise the drawer AI clean, main agent must FIRST add product-view-<id> testids OR test by clicking the 'View' link text in the row. Import wizard returns 413 on the provided sample xlsx – use a much smaller workbook (~50 rows) to reach the Preview step and verify plw-ai-summary-block.
rca of the issue: Spec mentions data-testid='settings-products' & 'product-drawer' open via 'view button'; in the live build the settings-tab uses 'settings-tab-products' and product rows use plain anchor text 'View' with no testid. Wizard upload endpoint rejects ~7k-row file with 413. Bundle 'Create bundle' click does not flip to Created – likely the POST /api/crm/products call failed; needs backend log inspection.
